# EncryptionOptions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Fluent builder for configuring PDF encryption options.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new EncryptionOptions()
```

## Methods

- [`AllowAccessibility`](#allowaccessibility): Allows extraction for accessibility purposes.
- [`AllowAll`](#allowall): Grants all permissions (least restrictive).
- [`AllowAnnotations`](#allowannotations): Allows adding and modifying annotations and filling forms.
- [`AllowAssembly`](#allowassembly): Allows document assembly (inserting, rotating, deleting pages).
- [`AllowCopying`](#allowcopying): Allows copying of text and graphics from the document.
- [`AllowFormFilling`](#allowformfilling): Allows filling of interactive form fields.
- [`AllowModification`](#allowmodification): Allows modification of the document.
- [`AllowPrinting`](#allowprinting): Allows printing of the document.
- [`DenyAll`](#denyall): Denies all permissions (most restrictive).
- [`EncryptMetadata`](#encryptmetadata): Sets whether to encrypt the document metadata.
- [`WithOwnerPassword`](#withownerpassword): Sets the owner password (required to change permissions).
- [`WithPassword`](#withpassword): Sets both user and owner passwords to the same value.
- [`WithPermissions`](#withpermissions): Sets the document permissions.
- [`WithUserPassword`](#withuserpassword): Sets the user password (required to open the document).
